module_objectives: Build a value hypothesis (Why Change, Why Now, Why Glean) tied to strategic priorities.
Write PBOs and a 3-5 metric hypothesis per line of business.
Run the prerequisites checklist and decide go / reschedule.
Send pre-work and agenda that set a consultative tone.

Given the supplied customer-neutral scenario and sources, write one complete metric hypothesis using What/How/Why. Successful output matches the worked response and states remaining uncertainty.
